messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: p99 latency spike and elevated 5xxs on inference-gateway (us-west-2) for /v1/generate — error rate ~5.4%, trending up. Paging @carol_oncall and @alice_sre
carol_oncall: ack. I'm on it, grabbing dashboards and traces.
alice_sre: looking at infra graphs now — connection failures to kvstore cluster noticed at 00:31 UTC.
bob_runtime: seeing large KV eviction spike + auth proxy 502s from gw-12/gw-14. Could be a warmup/affinity regression after the deploy.
dave_prod: we rolled the canary to 20% at 00:30, cut to 100% at 00:36 per deploy logs.
eve_support: CS: several customers reported timeouts around 00:38, CS ticket CS-1023 created. Notified enterprise contacts.
carol_oncall: initiating fast rollback to previous revision. @deploy-bot please start rollback. :rotating_light: 
deploy-bot: rollback requested by carol_oncall. Reverting to r2024-11-03-2, starting ops (estimate 90s).
alice_sre: while rollback runs, adding temporary route-level circuit on gateway to failover to fallback-model variant to reduce tail.
bob_runtime: attaching a quick snippet from the gateway logs (truncated):
```
ERROR kvstore: timeout after 250ms get key=prefix:session:abcd1234
WARN proxy: upstream 502 from kv-backend gw-14
TRACE svc: request 0x9f4f2 stalled at tail-kv for 6.1s
```
carol_oncall: set gateway request timeout to 500ms (was 3s) and enabled retry=1 backoff. Pushing config now.
frank_custsuccess: sent proactive message to affected customers: short note + workaround (use fallback model until resolved).
dave_prod: rollback in flight, monitoring rollback metrics. ETA ~2m.
deploy-bot: rollback complete at rev r2024-11-03-2.
carol_oncall: post-rollback telemetry: p95 down 1.9s -> 420ms, p99 down 6.2s -> 1.1s, 5xx rate back to ~0.2%. :thumbsup:
alice_sre: good stabilization. Creating incident ticket INC-774321 with initial hypothesis: kvcache seeding/affinity + a timing regression from new kernel flag in r2024-11-03-3.
bob_runtime: will capture kvcache heatmap and re-run local warmup tests. Also dumping GC and network stats from gw-12/14.
eve_support: updated CS-1023 with rollback status and ETA for postmortem. Customers acknowledged.
dave_prod: proposed immediate guardrail: block full cutover unless p99 < 1s for 15m after canary pass. Filing PR for deploy pipeline gate.
carol_oncall: handing to eng-runtime for next steps during on-call overlap — @bob_runtime please take lead for investigation and PM follow-up.
bob_runtime: taking it. Will post initial triage in INC-774321 and add tracer snapshots.
incidents-bot: Incident archived to INC-774321 (SEV3). Actions: rollback complete, temporary gateway timeout applied, customers notified.
_metadata_note: Thread is a contiguous Slack conversation string. Messages are presented in chronological order and prefixed with sender display names as required.
